title: Regiment and Atlas
author: Oscar Marchetti
blurb: Yara Sterling, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, has spent ten years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
